findings.text: non-blocking: StationProcess compares the station lease's host against _short_hostname() while reckon/crew/station.py:37 writes socket.gethostname(); on this node that is 98dci4-clu-2068 versus 98dci4-clu-2068.iter.org, so the own-host branch (and the os.kill liveness probe and stale-holder release it carries) is never taken and a live local station falls through the :1885 `elif holder is not None: return`. non-blocking: test_fleet_supervisor_starts_only_one_station's second ensure() returns on the instance's own live handle (fleet_supervisor.py:1866 `self.process.poll() is None`) and never reaches the node-lease read the one-station-per-node claim rests on, so deleting the holder check at fleet_supervisor.py:1872-1889 would leave this test green; only test_one_station_per_node_runs_the_tick.py:121 covers a second process refusing, and that is the station's own lease path, not the supervisor's.

non-blocking: test_dispatch_watch_ensures_station_before_producer asserts only that the station ensure was called once; nothing in it shows the call preceded the producer arming, so a regression that moved _ensure_node_station to the end of _ensure_watch_producer would pass under a name that claims ordering.

non-blocking: StationReloader re-implements the re-exec-into-a-materialised-committed-image recipe that reckon/crew/follower_reload.py:499 already owns, including its own environment-name set and launcher string, rather than extending or extracting the owner; the image machinery it calls (checkout_trust.materialize_committed_tree, source_code_identity, refresh_materialized_tree_pin) is properly reused, so the duplication is the exec/argv/environment recipe rather than the capability's core.
